description: Waypoint 18: Fixed critical bug in buildSystemPrompt — sections[] never merged to parts[], identity/emotion/narrative missing from prompt. Reverted to unified parts[]. 1969 tests pass.
Hierarchical goal decomposition with dependency tracking. LLM decomposes complex goals into sub-goals with parallel/sequential ordering. 3 new tests pass.
Conversational phase tracking — 6 phases (idle/greeting/exploration/deep-work/review/wrap-up) with phase-aware guidance in system prompt. 7 new unit tests.
Phase-strategy feedback loop — conversational phase overrides response strategy when confidence > 0.7. Context-aware response adaptation.
Semantic memory auto-extraction — rule-based extraction of preferences/skills/projects/deadlines/names. 11 new tests. 1243 tests pass.
Cross-goal conflict detection — Jaccard similarity + keyword contradiction patterns. Detect duplicate/overlap/contradiction. 6 new tests.
Tool chain templates — debug/feature/refactor/research workflow sequences injected into system prompt.
